query:
SELECT 
  ROUND(SUM(cat1+cat2+cat3+cat4+cat5+cat6+cat7+cat8), 2) as total_cat1_8,
  ROUND(SUM(cat9), 2) as total_cat9,
  ROUND(SUM(cat1+cat2+cat3+cat4+cat5+cat6+cat7+cat8+cat9), 2) as total_geral,
  COUNT(*) as dias_lancados,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cat1+cat2+cat3+cat4+cat5+cat6+cat7+cat8 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dias_com_faturamento
FROM faturamentos
WHERE empresaSlug = 'MORUMBI' 
  AND data LIKE '2026-03-%';
